interface.name: cutefish_status_item_manager_v1

description.summary: items an application draws in the menu bar

interface.description:
A status item is a surface of the client's that the menu bar shows among its items, at the bar's height and any width the client draws: an icon, a short text, a date, or an icon and a text. Pointer and touch input reach the surface as they reach any other; the client decides what a press does, typically opening a popup with the primary button and a menu with the secondary one.
Popups hang from an item through get_popup, so they are placed against it exactly and dismissed as any xdg_popup is. Popups never appear in the dock or the window switcher.

entry.name: role
entry.summary: the surface already has another role

request.name: get_status_item

description.summary: make a surface a status item

request.description: Gives the surface the status item role. The compositor answers with appearance, highlight and configure events once the menu bar can show the item; until the client acknowledges the first configure and commits a buffer, the item has no place in the bar. A surface that already has a role is the role error.

interface.name: cutefish_status_item_v1

description.summary: one item in the menu bar

interface.description:
The item's width is the width of its surface's content, in surface coordinates, as wp_viewporter or the buffer scale give it; its height is the one the last configure asked for. The surface is drawn at the scale of the output the bar is on, which wp_fractional_scale_v1 and wl_surface.preferred_buffer_scale report as for any surface.
Items stand in the bar in the order they were made, the newest leftmost. An item with an identifier takes the place that the last item of the same application with the same identifier had when it was destroyed, for the rest of the session. A surface without a buffer, or wider than the configure allows, has no place in the bar.
The bar draws its highlight plate behind the item while the client asks for it and while one of the item's grabbing popups is open.
Destroying the item takes it out of the bar and dismisses its popups; the surface keeps the role and cannot become anything else.

entry.name: unconfigured_buffer
entry.summary: a buffer was committed before the first configure was acknowledged

entry.name: invalid_serial
entry.summary: the serial was never sent or was already acknowledged

entry.name: invalid_popup
entry.summary: the popup has a parent already

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: a value is out of range

enum.name: appearance

description.summary: what the bar looks like behind its items

enum.description: The bar has no background of its own: its items are dark over a light desktop and light over a dark one.

description.summary: take the item out of the bar

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: The next commit is drawn for the configure with this serial, and for the ones before it.

request.name: set_identifier

description.summary: name the item within its application

request.description: A name that stays the same each time the application makes this item, so the item comes back to its place in the bar. Applies at once. An empty identifier is the default and remembers nothing.

request.name: set_highlight

description.summary: ask for the bar's highlight behind the item

request.description: A value of 1 shows the bar's highlight plate behind the item, as while a popup or menu of the item is open; 0 takes it away unless a grabbing popup of the item is open. 0 is the default; any other value is the invalid_value error. Applies at once.

request.name: get_popup

description.summary: hang a popup from the item

request.description:
Makes the item the parent of a popup made by xdg_surface.get_popup with a null parent. The positioner given there is read now, with its anchor rectangle in the item's surface coordinates: an anchor rectangle covering the item with bottom anchor and gravity hangs the popup centred under it. The popup is placed inside the work area of the bar's output and dismissed as any xdg_popup; while one of its popups has a grab, a press on the item itself reaches the client and does not dismiss it.
Must come before the popup's first commit. A popup that already has a parent is the invalid_popup error. While the item has no place in the bar, the popup is dismissed at once with xdg_popup.popup_done.

event.name: configure

description.summary: the size the bar has for the item

event.description: The item is drawn this tall, in surface coordinates, and at most max_width wide. The client acknowledges the configure before the commit that answers it. Sent when the bar first has a place for the item and whenever the bar's height or the room it has changes.

event.name: appearance

description.summary: the bar's look behind the item

event.description: Sent before the first configure and whenever it changes. foreground is the colour the bar draws its own text and symbols in, as 0xAARRGGBB with straight alpha: the colour to tint single-colour artwork with.

event.name: highlight

description.summary: whether the bar shows its highlight behind the item

event.description: Sent before the first configure and whenever it changes.

event.name: placed

description.summary: where the item is on the screen

event.description: The item's rectangle in the compositor's global logical coordinates, sent whenever it moves or changes size, with width and height 0 when the item has no place in the bar. A window that cannot be a popup of the item can open next to it with cutefish_window_hints_v1.set_placement_anchor.
